note: Set B correctly binds dimensions to their specific detail views (e.g., distinguishing C1's 3 1/2" from A6's 3 3/4" and correctly attributing the 8'-0" width to Detail C3), whereas Set A incorrectly attributes the 8'-0" width to the Decking Footing Plan (C1 is 1'-0") and invents a 'span 5-6'. Set A also mislabels the 7 1/2" dimension as joist depth (2x8 joists are 7 1/4") and conflates the Nut and Sleeve. While Set B has redundant claims and one direction error (calling the 8'-0" width a height in one instance), its entity-value bindings are significantly more faithful to the document structure.
